judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used to format the dataset, not a paper describing this dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: iEEG-BIDS is a specification for organizing intracranial EEG data, which this BIDS dataset follows; it does not describe this dataset itself.
judgments.paper_title: iEEG-BIDS, extending the Brain Imaging Data Structure specification to human intracranial electrophysiology
